title: AI Layer
purpose: Sends questions to the best available AI and learns which one answers well.
description: Sends a question to one of several AI services (such as Gemini, Groq or Mistral) and returns the answer. It remembers which service answers each kind of question best. It can run in test mode, where it only pretends, or live mode, where it really asks. It is not connected to Discord or Home Assistant.
navigation: Sends questions to the best AI
Keeps track of each AI's daily allowance
Switches between test and live mode
